isolation.baseline_harness_note: The first untapped failure also misclassified a disconnected watchdog channel as expiry; that harness error was corrected. The tapped report has PTY-interleaved panic stderr; raw output is preserved.

findings: Direct SDK and SourcePool bridge retain exact pixels; GPU taps locate the observed full-runtime mismatch after conversion at the outgoing SDK image handoff.
Golden opts into SDK GPU keyed shared textures before initialization. Detailed sends take zero-timeout CPU metadata then GPU image ownership; Busy does not copy or advance the counter.
Unchanged counter hints take only CPU metadata ownership. A held-GPU regression verifies no hint GPU submission and successful retry without counter advance on Busy.
Q01 captures all 180 sample-accepted images with exact pixels; both interruption phases capture 60/60 exactly.
Q02 captures 148/176 sample-accepted images with zero observed pixel mismatches; 28 remain uncaptured. Minimized captures 46/58, disconnected 36/61 with 16 missing-source captures.
Q02 cadence and source age remain insufficient. No native recovery or full qualification gate closes.
limitations: Finite single-source regression and short two-source controls do not qualify sustained cadence, source admission, complete capture coverage, handles or growth.
GPU taps and final readback exist only in opt-in native tests, can perturb timing, and are complemented by an untapped production runtime case.
CPU API acceptance and completed captures do not prove physical presentation, window age, GPU queue time or a cross-context critical path.
Real device-removal and bounded stuck-driver retirement remain open under M03 gate 4.
Named-mutex legacy input regression remains covered; foreign sender GPU synchronization guarantees depend on that peer. DX9 is outside the selected route.
Late Spout Busy occurs inside send after conversion and may retain conversion/API intervals; only existing window preflight rejects before conversion.
